question: Good Governance Day is observed annually on 25 December on the birth anniversary of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Atal Bihari Vajpayee.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Good Governance Day (GGD) is observed on December 25 of every year in India.
 
• The birth anniversary of former Prime Minister and Bharat Ratna Atal Bihari Vajpayee is celebrated as Good Governance Day across the country.
 
• The day aims to let the citizens, the students, who are the future of the country know about the government's responsibilities and duties that it needs to fulfill.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee was born on 25 December 1924 in Gwalior Madhya Pradesh.__
 
• He was one of the founding members of the Bharatiya Jana Sangh and later became its national president.
 
• Atal Bihari Vajpayee won the election from Lucknow parliamentary constituency and became the tenth Prime Minister of India.
 
• Atal Bihari Vajpayee has given his membership in both the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha.
 
• He was awarded Bharat Ratna, India's highest honour in the year 2015.
 
• Atal Bihari Vajpayee was the first foreign minister of India who give a speech in Hindi at the United Nations.
 
• He died in Delhi on 16 August 2018 due to prolonged illness.
